# REAL Solutions Group

> REAL Solutions Group is a regulatory consulting firm specializing in pharmacy compliance, drug supply chain management, and NABP accreditation services.

REAL Solutions Group provides comprehensive regulatory consulting for pharmacies and drug distributors across the United States and US territories. The firm offers expertise in licensing compliance, NABP accreditation (including Drug Distributor Accreditation and Digital Pharmacy), temperature mapping, compounding compliance, and regulatory tracking to ensure clients meet federal and state requirements.

## Key Topics

- NABP (National Association of Boards of Pharmacy)
- Drug Distributor Accreditation (DDA)
- NABP Digital Pharmacy Accreditation
- VIPPS (Verified Internet Pharmacy Practice Sites)
- DSCSA (Drug Supply Chain Security Act)
- Pharmacy Licensing Compliance
- VPP (Verification of Pharmacy Products)
- USP-NF Compounding Standards
- Temperature Mapping & Facility Qualification
- HealthRISC Regulatory Tracking
- Sterile Preparation Compliance
- Regulatory Consulting
- Pharmacy Accreditation
- Drug Supply Chain Management
- State Pharmacy Board Compliance

## Core Compliance Services

- [Licensing Compliance](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/licensing-compliance): State licensing compliance services across US, Puerto Rico, Guam, and Virgin Islands.
- [Licensing Renewals](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/renewals): Pharmacy license renewal management and compliance services with NABP support.
- [NABP Drug Distributor Accreditation](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/nabp-drug-distributor-accreditation): NABP Drug Distributor Accreditation consulting aligned with DSCSA requirements.
- [Regulatory Tracking](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/regulatory-tracking): HealthRISC regulatory tracking and monthly reporting for drug supply chain compliance.
- [Temperature Mapping](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/temperature-mapping): Temperature mapping and facility qualification services per USP-NF and WHO standards.
- [Compounding & VPP](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/compounding-vpp-1): USP compounding compliance and VPP inspection services for sterile preparations.
- [Digital Health](https://www.realsolutionsgroup.co/digital-health): NABP Digital Pharmacy and VIPPS accreditation for online pharmacy compliance.
